The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints operates thousands of local Family History Centers worldwide, small genealogy research rooms typically housed inside individual meetinghouses and staffed by volunteers, offering public access to FamilySearch resources, microfilm readers, and a handful of research computers. These are patron facing genealogy research spaces, not server rooms or computing data centers, and no published source describes server or IT infrastructure at this Bear Lake County location specifically. This differs from the Church well documented, purpose built records preservation infrastructure elsewhere, such as the Granite Mountain Records Vault in Utah, which is not the facility tied to this record. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
